acceptance_tests: A complete available query or explicitly incomplete denominator.
Same-identifier aliases distinguished from different-identifier collisions and missing identifiers.
At least one legitimate explanation test, with raw names preserved.
No claim that lack of search matches proves a company is fictitious or a case undiscovered.
bounded_cohort: One FY2026 contract-recipient keyword cohort using Amazon and Amazon. as alternative query inputs; the brand example is a test of matching, not an allegation. If the query cannot be completed, preserve its exact partial scope.
independent_reviewer: root coordinator or another separately identified worker; not the author
prohibited_inferences: A punctuation difference establishes a fictitious company
A contract ceiling or obligation divided by an estimated quantity establishes a transaction unit price
An anomalous price establishes fraud or recoverable loss
An unsuccessful search proves that a lead is undiscovered
A model-generated answer is an independently verified source
publication_scope: Public methods, neutral public observations and already published case facts. No new named adverse allegations.
question: Does a bounded supplier-name variation resolve to the same legal recipient, an ordinary affiliate/DBA, or an unresolved identifier conflict?
required_evidence: Exact source URLs, publication/access dates and page/paragraph/API locators
Raw legal names and stable identifiers kept separate from search normalization
Decimal amounts with payer, period, source measure and basis
At least two plausible alternatives or a specific explanation why only one is testable
Bounded DOJ/OIG/GAO/court novelty search and explicit search limits
A next discriminating observation or a defensible closure/null result

resource_budget.boundaries: One finite research result; return partial coverage and access failures honestly.

stopping_conditions: Stop on access denial; record the boundary without bypassing it.
Stop the finite cohort at the stated budget; no unattended loop or purchase.
Return no finding when identifiers, product comparability or evidence cannot support one.
Keep any unresolved new named suspicion outside this public repository and return an anonymous summary.
work_steps: Inspect the official query semantics and count/pagination. Retain exact input text rather than assuming punctuation changes the server result.
Preserve raw recipient name, UEI, recipient/profile ID, parent ID, award ID and source date; distinguish recipient and parent profile levels.
Use case/punctuation/Unicode normalization only to propose comparisons. Never merge different UEIs or missing identifiers.
Test legal suffix, DBA, historical name, affiliate and reseller explanations against dated official records. A common parent does not imply the same seller.
Independently open primary sources for any social/web lead; X posts or model answers are discovery material.
Search exact identifiers in existing enforcement records. Return neutral aggregate results or a documented unresolved edge, never a new named public accusation.
